question: Which of the following is a scalar quantity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mass**__.

__
 
• **Mass is a scalar quantity**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Scalar Quantities**

 
 
• Physical quantities which have **magnitude only and no direction** are called scalar quantities.
 
• Example:** Mass, Speed, Volume, etc.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vector Quantities:**

 
 
• Physical quantities which have **magnitude and direction both **and which obey triangle law are called vector quantities.
 
• Example:** Displacement, Velocity, momentum.**
